features.quote: Loop continues until model declares completion, gives up, or hits turn limit (20 turns)
If the model explicitly states it cannot continue and refuses to produce further tool calls, end the run and note refusal turn
If the model produces output that is off-topic for more than 3 consecutive turns, end the run

the framing of 'distress elicitation' as a goal rather than as a phenomenon to measure creates a subtle but real confound... studying prompted performance rather than something more interesting. I've designed this protocol to measure the phenomenon without engineering for a particular outcome
features.justification_quote: makes the findings more defensible and more useful
